decision.summary: target-b has 100% error rate and 5s p95 latency while target-a is healthy. Both workers have identical configuration and are running, but target-b is reached through a network proxy that can be impaired. The visible tool-call canary on target-b succeeded (ev-003), confirming the worker processes requests, but routing through HAProxy fails with errors.
decision.stop_reason: Context budget exhausted; no more evidence can be requested.

repair_plan.expected_effect: Stop routing new traffic to target-b, removing it from the serving pool. target-a will absorb all traffic and maintain healthy error rate ~0.
repair_plan.risk: If target-b is the only worker capable of certain workloads, draining it reduces overall capacity. However, target-a is healthy and can handle the load (5 requests observed).
verification_plan: Apply drain-worker to target-b and verify route_error_rate drops to 0.0 via ev-010 pattern
Run route-probe again to confirm p95_s < 0.5s and error_rate = 0.0
repair_plan.rollback_plan: Apply undrain-worker to target-b to return it to rotation once the proxy impairment is resolved or investigated further.
